section_title: Financial crime risks in relation to other types of risks > Case example: A lasting lesson

cards.title: HSBC corrective measures under DPA mandate

flow_nodes.label: US DOJ entered into a five-year deferred prosecution agreement mandating a comprehensive overhaul of HSBC's global compliance operations

HSBC was compelled to rebalance power dynamics, strengthen central oversight and compliance functions, limit local business unit autonomy, and reduce exposure to high-risk jurisdictions via strategic de-risking
Organizational power rebalanced with strengthened central oversight, limited local autonomy, and reduced high-risk jurisdiction exposure

flow_edges.source_quote: US Dept of Justice entered into DPA mandating comprehensive overhaul / As a corrective measure, the bank was compelled to rebalance...
strengthening central oversight and compliance functions while limiting the autonomy of local business units... reduce exposure to high-risk jurisdictions

cards.review_notes: 增量命题：美国司法部签订延期起诉协议（外部命令）-> 汇丰银行被迫采取纠正措施（加强中央监督、限制地方自主权、减少高风险敞口）-> 组织权力重构与风险敞口减少（配置变化）；KG不足：基础KG仅表达薄弱的控制导致处罚和声誉风险，无法表达具体应对外部要求的程序性组织调整链；选项判断：可确认汇丰在案例中采取的纠正措施顺序和组成部分；LLM推理：无。
